text:
Lina: heads-up — sales surfaced two pilot customers asking for per-user export & advanced filters, asking this week if MVP will include it.
Tom: exports were scoped for v1 in the doc. MVP was core inference + basic analytics.
Sunil: agreed. Full exports mean auth, pagination, S3 flows — easily 2 sprints backend + infra.
Carla: we need a decision: push MVP date or cut exports. Current launch window is Jun 9.
Emma: from sales: both pilots will sign if we give a reliable ETA and a temporary workaround (CSV dump). Not absolute blockers.
Raj: can we ship with an API hook that supports later export? i.e., capture export-ready payloads now but not UI.
Tom: technically we can persist the export payloads and expose them later. That reduces upfront UI work.
Lina: proposal: 1) Ship MVP on Jun 9 with core product + basic analytics counters + webhook hooks. 2) Defer export UI and advanced filters to v1 (Q3). 3) Offer manual CSV dumps to pilots until UI ships.
Sunil: impact: removes 2 sprints of frontend + 1 infra sprint. Backend storage + schema tweaks = 1 sprint. Good win.
Carla: tradeoffs documented. We keep a feature flag for exports so we can dark-launch if needed.
Tom: can we list the concrete cutlist so eng & design are aligned?
Lina: yes — quick cutlist:
```
MVP_cutlist:
- exports_ui: false
- advanced_filters: false
- realtime_alerts: basic (no SLAs)
- integrations: webhook-only (no full connector)
- onboarding_demo_data: trimmed
```
Emma: sales ok with that as long as we commit to a public v1 ETA and roadmap card.
Carla: I'll create a public v1 roadmap card and link pilots. ETA target: patch & schedule for early Sept (Q3).
Raj: owners: 
- CSV manual dumps: Support (Raj) — immediate
- Persist export payloads: Sunil/backend
- Expose webhook hooks: Tom/frontend infra
- Roadmap + customer comms: Carla
Lina: quick vote: thumbs up = cut exports to hit Jun 9; thumbs down = delay launch to include exports.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Sunil: :thumbsup:
Carla: :thumbsup:
Raj: :thumbsup:
Emma: :thumbsup: (will tell pilots)
deploy-bot: feature-flag 'export_ui' created (off) by Lina — see /flags
Lina: thanks team. I'll update the launch doc and send comms to pilots + sales.
Tom: will update the engineering milestone tracker and adjust sprint scope.
Carla: follow-up sync Friday 11am to confirm no new blocker.
Lina: noted. End of thread.
